subject.title: feat(feeds): choose publisher feeds from signed profiles

question: Should publisher following, scheduled remote-feed refresh, and its durable state be a core Gateway/Control UI capability, or should the repository expose generic seams and keep publisher-specific behavior in an owner plugin?
rationale: The patch creates a broad user-facing core surface, six operator RPCs, background network activity, and two shared database tables; implementation review cannot choose that permanent ownership and migration direction safely.

options.title: Approve the core architecture
options.body: Sponsor the core capability and require the protocol registry, schema-upgrade contract, dependency order, and live security/upgrade proof before merge.

options.title: Move publisher behavior outward
options.body: Retain only genuinely missing generic plugin APIs in core and implement publisher following, refresh policy, and UI ownership in the appropriate plugin.

options.title: Pause the stack
options.body: Keep the drafts open without further landing work until the feed product and trust model have an agreed owner.

recommendation.title: Approve the core architecture
recommendation.body: Sponsor the core capability and require the protocol registry, schema-upgrade contract, dependency order, and live security/upgrade proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision spans core product scope, Gateway protocol, Control UI, and shared persistent-state governance rather than one implementation file.
